title: Piri-piri chicken with roast vegetables
steps: Blend the chilli, garlic, paprika, lemon juice, vinegar, 2 tsp oil and salt into a marinade and marinate the chicken for 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C, cut the sweet potato, pepper and onion into chunks and toss with the remaining oil.
Spread the vegetables on a tray, place the chicken on top and bake for 25–30 minutes until cooked and lightly browned.
